_comment: Size-limit exceptions the owner accepted on 2026-11-11 (files error over 500 lines; functions warn over 50 and error over 80 per owner 2026-11-13; blank lines and comments not counted by ESLint). The limits are a tripwire: anything over the error limit gets a responsibility-based split or an entry here with a reason the owner agreed to. Ratchet: new code must comply; accepted exceptions stay separate from the shrink-only debt list. Do not add an entry to silence a new finding; split it instead, or get an owner-agreed reason. NOT exempt on purpose: apps/website/src/server/runtime/composition/deps.ts and composition/app.ts (composeSiteRouteDeps, createRouteDeps) are the top hotspots and get split by feature in the refactor. Read by development/scripts/size-hotspots.mjs and the size gate. The Jini entries move to the Jini repo when the size gate lands there.

limits._exceptionsNote: Path exclusions are size-gate ignores; entries are individual file or function exceptions with reasons. New exception candidates go to the owner; the refactoring agent does not decide them.
